name: io.github.sassoftware/sas-mcp-server
title: SAS Viya
description: Execute SAS code and query Compute, CAS, and model APIs on SAS Viya via OAuth 2.0.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the SAS Viya CLI token cache into the container. The server reads ~/.sas/credentials.json, and $HOME is /app inside the image, so the .sas directory has to land at /app/.sas.

sas_token_dir.description: The .sas directory in your home directory, written by `sas-viya auth loginCode`. On Windows, C:\Users\<you>\.sas.

environmentVariables.name: VIYA_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your SAS Viya environment, e.g. https://viya.example.com. No trailing slash.

environmentVariables.name: SSL_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set false only for a self-signed Viya certificate. Disables verification for the whole process, so prefer a trusted certificate.

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: SASLogon OAuth client id used for the token refresh exchange.

environmentVariables.name: COMPUTE_CONTEXT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Compute context that backs SAS code execution.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Expose only some tool tiers, e.g. 0-4 or 0,1,7. Empty exposes all 92 tools. Tiers: 0 Compute, 1 Data Discovery, 2 Data Operations, 3 Reports, 4 Batch Jobs, 5 AutoML, 6 Models, 7 Decisioning, 8 Workbench, 9 Business Glossary.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Expose only tools that neither change server-side state nor cause server-side work (51 of 92). Composes with MCP_TIERS.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Register interactive views (MCP Apps) for the data, SAS log and glossary tools. Additive: text-only clients are unaffected. Set false to register none.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_DRAFT
environmentVariables.description: Email draft on the decision scoring view's result card: outlook (an Outlook on the web draft), mail (the default mail app) or off (no email controls). The person sends the draft themselves; nothing is sent by the server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STATELESS_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Serve HTTP requests without an MCP session. Needed by clients that speak only the sessionless 2026-07-28 protocol revision (claude.ai custom connectors); the legacy handshake works either way.

environmentVariables.name: VIYA_CLIENT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for every SAS Viya REST call the tools make.
